perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.description: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

enhanced.name: Cornered
enhanced.description: Faster charge time or draw time and increased stability when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.description:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

enhanced.name: Well-Rounded
enhanced.description:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants an improved stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Backup Plan
perks.description: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for a short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

enhanced.name: Backup Plan
enhanced.description: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for an improved short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

enhanced.name: Pugilist
enhanced.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate improved melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

enhanced.name: Voltshot
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for an improved short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.description: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.name: Under Pressure
enhanced.description: Greatly improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Surrounded
enhanced.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage when three or more targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.description: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Kickstart
enhanced.description: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for an improved duration.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.description: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

enhanced.name: Tap the Trigger
enhanced.description: Grants an improved short period of greatly increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.description: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

enhanced.name: Reservoir Burst
enhanced.description: When the battery is full, your next burst is improved, dealing additional damage and causing targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.description: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.name: Closing Time
enhanced.description: Further improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

enhanced.name: Gear Shift
enhanced.description: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a longer period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

flavor: "I see now that everything dies. Even… even memory." —Midha, Consort of Stars
